notes: New 💎 Premium shop at the top of the Arcade shop, with chat bubbles for 1 million points and up: Diamond, Galaxy, Royal gold, the legendary Phoenix, Aurora, Dragon and Legendary Shadow Crow, and The Ultimate for 100 million. Each has its own entrance, and clicking any bubble's picture opens a preview of how it looks in the chat. You can now send any amount of points to people (no more 5,000 limit). The chat, casino and blackjack are also much lighter: bubbles and top-3 names no longer pulse or shimmer non-stop, so it runs smoothly on slower computers.
